name: iro-quests
author: Lil Art
description: iRO's permanent quests the server has no script for: Bounty Boards, Criminal Activities, Eye of the Beholder, Overlook Water Dungeon, Gramps' weekly turn-ins and City Investment.

settings.label: Bounty Boards
settings.description: iRO's Bounty Boards in 28 towns and dungeons: hunt 150 of a monster for EXP, zeny and Eden Merit Badges. Turning them off keeps everyone's hunts in their quest log.

settings.label: Criminal Activities
settings.description: iRO's Criminal Activities Quest (Base Level 70): free Vince Noir's band from Jymmy the Thumb, from Geffen to the domestic airship. Starts with Agent York in the Geffen inn.

settings.label: Eye of the Beholder
settings.description: iRO's Eye of the Beholder (Base Level 50): help Beho the beholder win Bianca's heart in Rachel. Starts with the Beholder on the international airship's deck.

settings.label: Overlook Water Dungeon
settings.description: iRO's Overlook Water Dungeon (Base Level 30-85): the Byalan copy under The Sign west of Geffen, with its 15 Aged monsters and 5 floor hunts. Turning it off removes the monsters and the hunts.

settings.label: Gramps' weekly turn-ins
settings.description: iRO's Gramps at the Eden Group (Base Level 70-150): 400-kill hunts, two monsters a week per tier, for 400x the monster's EXP, 65,000 zeny and an Eden Merit Badge. Replaces rAthena's talk-only Gramps.

settings.label: City Investment (Merchant Union)
settings.description: Join the City Merchant Union at the Eden Group, earn Union Insignias from monsters and Union requests (111 deliveries, weekly Wanted bosses), invest them in 9 cities and buy their account-bound Union gear.

settings.label: Town quests (2021 revamp)
settings.description: kRO's 2021 town quests that iRO runs: so far Morroc, Payon, Prontera (with Orc Village and Glast Heim), Izlude, Aldebaran and the Juno fields, Hugel, Einbroch and Lighthalzen, with their dailies, shared with the Eden Group's mission boards.
